claims.evidence: Dynamic SILAC, not a mixture of samples: PRIDE/paper 4.3 'The fibroblasts were cultured in standard, light (L) DMEM medium until they reached confluence ... the heavy medium (containing the 13C6-Lysine) was added to the culture at time T=0. Cells were harvested at 4, 7.5 and 24 h'. So in every run the light channel is the pre-existing proteome and the heavy channel the protein synthesised after T=0 (paper 2.1/4.6: H/L ratio models PH/PL). msf ProcessingNodeParameters QuantificationMethod = 'SILAC 2plex (Lys6) (Custom)' in all 30 msf (multiplicity 2). One source per (subject, time point, channel); no two cultures share a source name.

claims.value: individual = cell36, cell42, cell80, cell160, cell268, cell304, cell325, cell504, cell511, cell515; biological replicate = 1..10 in that order, restarting within each sampling-time group
claims.evidence: Raw/msf file names carry the subject code cellNNN; ten codes, matching the paper's '10 type 1 diabetic patients' and '300 LC-MS/MS analyses (2 analyses for each of the five gel bands, for the three time points, and for the 10 patients)'. Each subject is one independent primary culture, so within every factor-value group (sampling time) the ten subjects get the distinct numbers 1-10 (README.adoc:330, campaign rule 3). The same subject keeps the same number across time points.

claims.location: characteristics[sampling time], factor value[sampling time] rows 1-624
claims.evidence: Cells harvested at 4, 7.5 and 24 h after the switch to heavy medium (PRIDE protocol; paper 4.3). File tokens 04h / 07h / 24h; '07h' = 7.5 h (the only stated intermediate time point). Time after label switch is the variable the turnover model fits (paper eq. 5), hence the factor.

claims.evidence: Paper 4.2: 'The fibroblasts were obtained by skin biopsies ... skin explants'; primary cultures grown to passage 4-5 (not an established cell line, so material type 'cell' and no cell-lines template). Biopsy site not stated, hence the general UBERON:0002097 skin of body; CL:0000057 fibroblast (PRIDE organismParts lists CL:0000057 Fibroblast and BTO primary cell).

Paper 4.1: 'Five Caucasian T1DM patients with DN ... and five T1DM patients without DN' - every subject has T1DM (MONDO:0005147; PRIDE diseases DOID:9744). Nephropathy status is per subject and cannot be assigned (see limitations), so it is not encoded.

PRIDE/paper 4.3: SILAC experiment in custom-made DMEM without Arg/Lys/Gln, supplemented with Arg, Gln and Lys or 13C6-Lys, 10% dialysed FBS (earlier expansion was in HAM's F-10; the measured cultures were in DMEM).

limitations: Diabetic nephropathy status per subject is NOT annotated: the paper and Supplementary Tables S1-S5 label subjects only as Diab1-5 / Nephro1-5, the deposit only as cell36, cell42, cell80, cell160, cell268, cell304, cell325, cell504, cell511, cell515; no retrieved source links the two codings (PRIDE protocol, paper, supplementary zip, Figure S4 which names only Cell_268, msf metadata). Ref [20] (patients' characteristics, Proteomics Clin Appl 2008, PMID 21136853) is not open access. The study's DN vs diabetic-control comparison therefore cannot be reproduced from this SDRF; recorded in BLOCKED.md (partial block, attribute only - no run is excluded).
Per-subject age, sex, ancestry and developmental stage are not available (only cohort means; 'Caucasian' is stated for the DN group sentence only).

Technical replicates 3/4 (cell36 24h second series; cell42 24h band-E re-acquisitions) are inferred to be re-injections of the same sample because they were merged into the same msf; the reason for the repeat is not stated.
Instrument: paper and raw header say LTQ Orbitrap XL; the acquisition PC is named 'LTQ Orbitrap ETD', so the hardware may be the XL ETD variant (MS:1000639); MS:1000556 kept.
Paper 4.5 says 'up to 1 missed cleavage'; every msf records MissedCleavages = 2 (no SDRF column; noted).
Raw headers were checked on 2 of 312 files (one first-pass, one exclusion-list run).
